dose.selection: High in vitro arms; identical unique nominal concentrations at 24 h across species; paired time contrasts additionally require the same concentration at both times
dose.concentration_note: Nominal concentration is not intracellular exposure; mass and molar units are not interconverted

multiplicity.method: Holm step-down, using unrounded deposited p-values
multiplicity.main_family: All 18 Table 3 tests: 3 time pairs × 3 summaries × raw/row-adjusted matrices; selected post hoc
multiplicity.scope: Within-table sensitivity, not study-wide confirmatory error control

hepatocyte_donors.interpretation: Each deposited response averages three paired donor log-ratio profiles. These are replicated source data; donor-level matrix reliability was not estimated in the cross-tissue analysis.
